description: Get recent posts from Donald Trump's Truth Social account (@realDonaldTrump). Each post includes AI-generated stock market impact analysis identifying affected tickers and predicted price directions. By default only returns posts with identified market impact; set showAll=true to include all posts. Use offset to paginate through older posts.

lang.description: Language for the market impact analysis text. 'en' = English, 'zh' = Chinese. Default: 'en'

limit.description: Number of posts to return (1-20). Default: 5

showAll.description: If true, show all posts including those without market impact. Default: false (market-impact posts only)

name: get_trump_posts
